ApplyOptions.description: holds the values for the `.distro.apply` section of the config file

DistroCreateOptions.description: holds the values for the `.distro.create` section of the config file

registry_override.description:
maps a source registry to the registry cargoship uses instead
when pulling images, for example {"docker.io": "mirror.example.com"}

skip_sbom.description: whether we will scan the images or files

DistroDeployOptions.description: holds the values for the `.distro.deploy` section of the config file

retries.description: how many times we will try to push a package

DistroOptions.description: holds the values for the `.distro` section of the config file

apply.description: are options used by the apply subcommand

certificate_identity.description: required identity claim in the signing certificate

certificate_identity_regexp.description: equired identity claim in the signing certificate, allows usage of regex

certificate_oidc_issuer.description: required OIDC issuer claim in the signing certificate

certificate_oidc_issuer_regexp.description: required OIDC issuer claim in the signing certificate, allows usage of regex

concurrency.description: how many nodes we will try to interact with at a time, 0 means that all nodes will be done at once

create.description: are options used by the create subcommand

deploy.description: are options used by the deploy subcommand

fapolicy.description: whether we will update hosts with fapolicyd

firewall_update.description: whether we will update the host firewall

host_update.description: whether we will update the etc host file

oci_concurrency.description: is how many concurrent oci artifacts that will be pushed at a time

output.description: the folder that we will create the distro tar balls in

public_key.description: path to public key file for validating signed packages

publish.description: are options used by the publish subcommand

reset.description: ResetOptions are options used by the reset subcommand

retry.description: number of retries we will try

trusted_root.description: path to a Sigstore TrustedRoot JSON

type.description: of distro we are interacting with

use_signed_timestamps.description: verify RFC3161 signed timestamps in the bundle. Auto-enabled when the bundle contains TSA timestamp data.

worker_concurrency.description: number of worker nodes that will be upgraded at once

DistroPublishOptions.description: holds the values for the `.distro.publish` section of the config file

signing_key.description: is the path to the private key, a Cosign-supported key provider, used to sign, or re-sign, the package

signing_key_password.description: the password for the private key used for signing

RegistryOverrideMap.description: maps a source registry to the registry cargoship uses instead.

ResetOptions.description: holds the values for the `.distro.reset` section of the config file

description: holds the values for the `.`, or root, section of the config file

architecture.description: the CPU architecture to use for OCI operations

distro.description: are various options used by the command

log_format.description: how the logs are displayed well running

log_level.description: the level of logs that will be displayed

no_color.description: whether to disable terminal color codes in logging and stdout prints

timeout.description: the longest we will run long ran tasks before failing

tmp_dir.description: the directory where we store stuff before deleting them

zarf_cache.description: is the folder where oras artifacts are stored
